The rest of the multi-task learning setup uses a shared-private model architecture, with a 4-level hierarchical structure in which shared-layer outputs are filtered by a selected sharing layer before a softmax output layer classifies each task.

The paper proposes a novel sifted multi-task learning method built on a shared-private model to jointly train stance detection and fake news detection, filtering the original outputs of the shared layer via a selected sharing layer; the model consists of a 4-level hierarchical structure [4]. The shared-private feature extractor (like the attention sharing cell) adopts transformer encoder [3][11], and the output layer applies softmax functions to each task's concatenation of private features and selected-sharing-layer outputs [8]. The selected sharing structure fuses a single gate mechanism for filtering useless shared features with an attention mechanism for attending to features helpful to the target tasks [2].

The selected sharing struc- ture fused single gate mechanism for ﬁltering use- less shared features and attention mechanism for paying close attention to features that were helpful to target tasks.

Specif- ically, this cell utilizes input embeddings of the speciﬁc task to weight shared features for paying more attention to helpful features. The inputs of this cell include two matrixes: the input embed- dings of the speciﬁc task and the shared features of both tasks. The basic attention architecture of this cell, the same as shared-private feature extrac- tor, also adopts transformer encoder (the details in subsection 3.2).

3 Method We propose a novel sifted multi-task learning method on the ground of shared-private model to jointly train the tasks of stance detection and fake news detection, ﬁlter original outputs of shared layer by a selected sharing layer. Our model con- sists of a 4-level hierarchical structure, as shown in Figure 2. Next, we will describe each level of our proposed model in detail.

3.4 The Output Layer As the last layer, softmax functions are applied to achieve the classiﬁcation of different tasks, which emits the prediction of probability distribution for the speciﬁc task i. ˆyi = softmax(WiFi + bi) Fi = [Hi; SSLi] where ˆyi is the predictive result, Fi is the concatena- tion of private features Hi of task i and the outputs SSLi of selected sharing layer for task i. Wi and bi are trainable parameters.
In this work, we utilize transformer encoder to acquire semantics from responses and forwarding of fake news for stance detection.
